# VERGE

VERGE is a digital growth and intelligence consultancy that helps businesses build stronger digital foundations, become easier to discover, communicate their value more clearly, and convert digital attention into real business opportunities.

VERGE combines strategy, brand, web, visibility, and intelligent digital systems to help businesses compete in a world where customers increasingly discover businesses through search, platforms, and AI-powered systems.

## Core Services

- **Brand & Identity**: Brand Strategy, Logo & Identity Systems, Visual Identity, Brand Guidelines, Digital Brand Systems.
- **Website & Digital Experience**: Website Design & Development, Responsive Digital Experiences, Conversion-Focused Landing Pages, Business Websites.
- **AI-Ready Web & Visibility**: Machine-readable web architecture, Structured data, Entity clarity, Search & Local foundations. We improve the public digital signals and machine-readable information that help modern discovery systems understand a business.
- **Digital Marketing**: Content Strategy, Social Media Strategy, Campaign Creative, Digital Advertising, Lead Generation.
- **Conversion Systems**: Landing Pages, CTA Strategy, Lead Capture, Contact & Quote Flows, Booking Systems, Conversion Optimization.
- **Content & Authority**: Educational Content, Search Content, Customer Question Strategy, Case Studies, Thought Leadership.

## ordigit
ordigit is VERGE's flagship Business Visibility Intelligence product. It investigates the digital evidence surrounding a business and turns it into visibility intelligence, search & local insights, AI readiness, trust signals, customer intent, and actionable growth intelligence. ordigit connects signals across Business & Website Clarity, AI Visibility, Search & Local Presence, Content & Authority, Trust & Reputation, and Customer Conversion.

## Industries Served
VERGE works with businesses across various industries, including but not limited to:
- Roofing & Contractors
- Real Estate
- Professional Services
- Tech & SaaS
- Creators & Personal Brands
- Clinics / Local Services
